notes.note: Checked against run-e2e-suite.mjs: the browser smoke suite, its reporters and its evidence are unchanged; the failure manifest is written only when the manifest directory is set. Re-read against the qualification failure manifest change: the Vitest corpus runner, phase driver and e2e suite write a structured failure manifest only when STATION_QUALIFICATION_MANIFEST_DIR is set, corpus and Android jobs upload it on failure, and the repair and health trackers classify red runs from it in report mode unless STATION_QUALIFICATION_SIGNAL is enforce. No test selection, verdict, permission or release behaviour changes. This document makes no claim about those behaviors; no prose change needed.
